# OKF Conformance Checking

The `check_bundle` function evaluates all `.md` files in a specified directory against conformance rules to ensure they meet structural and frontmatter requirements. It identifies any issues related to missing or non-compliant frontmatter fields based on the OKF standards, thereby helping maintain consistency and validity of wiki content.
